record.body:
## Description

In ~/se-workflow/contract/project-design.json, add a dashboard view with roles: goal, current phase, needs-you (blocking questions, open non-blocking questions, needs=human findings, unsigned manual checks), running (in_progress work-items with assignee), ready (planned, derived.ready true), waiting (planned, derived.ready false), done in the last 24h. Use label_fields. Waits for label-view-fields and recency-selection.

payload.title: Add the dashboard view to the se-workflow contract

record.subject: add-dashboard-view
